meta.name: analyzing-powershell-empire-artifacts
meta.description: Detect PowerShell Empire framework artifacts in Windows event logs by identifying Base64 encoded launcher patterns, default user agents, staging URL structures, stager IOCs, and known Empire module signatures in Script Block Logging events.

copy.tagline: 从Windows事件日志中识别PowerShell Empire攻击痕迹
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要检测Windows环境中PowerShell Empire框架的入侵痕迹
copy.tagline_en: Detect PowerShell Empire artifacts in Windows event logs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to identify PowerShell Empire framework intrusions in Windows environments

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能分析 Windows 事件日志，找出 PowerShell Empire 框架的痕迹，比如默认启动命令、Base64 编码的载荷、已知模块调用等，并输出包含 IOC、解码载荷、时间线和 MITRE ATT&CK 映射的 JSON 报告。
howto.when: 当用户提供 Windows 事件日志（EVTX 文件或日志数据），且需要检测 PowerShell Empire 框架的痕迹时触发。

say.text: 分析这个 EVTX 文件，查找 PowerShell Empire 的启动命令。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze Windows event logs to detect PowerShell Empire framework artifacts, such as default launcher commands, Base64-encoded payloads, and known module invocations, and output a JSON report with IOCs, decoded payloads, timeline, and MITRE ATT&CK mappings.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides Windows event logs (EVTX files or log data) and needs to detect PowerShell Empire framework artifacts.

say_en.text: Analyze this EVTX file for PowerShell Empire launcher commands.
say_en.note: Claude will scan logs for default launcher strings and Base64 payloads.

say_en.text: Check logs for Invoke-Mimikatz or Invoke-Kerberoast calls.
say_en.note: Claude will match known Empire module signatures.
